QuestInfo.name: Spider's Out at Eos Tower
QuestInfo.0: The King's #b#p2041022##k is in need of help. What must it be? I better head over to #b#m220000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2041022# received orders to deliver the King's Royal Letter to #m221000000#, but he's having a little spider problem at Eos Tower. Go take out #r20 each#k of the #r#o2230103##k and #r#o2230104##k bugs in #b#m221022500##k and #b#m221022600##k so he can get through.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to eliminate #o2230103# and #o2230104#. I'm sure now #p2041022# can do his job. I thought #p2041022# was unafraid of anything else in life besides the King. Spiders? That was unexpected...

0.0: Hoh... what should I do? I can never go against his royal highness, but... the spiders... the spiders... hmmm... what? How can I help you? How can Tigun help you? \r\n#L0# #b You seem very concerned. What's going on?
0.1: What concern... I am the King's aide, and I should not be concerned about anything. It is really nothing... NOTHING. N.O.T.H.I.N.G... Haha...\r\n#L0# #bYou seem pale. You're drenched in sweat...
0.2: What... what sweat? Oh... it's nothing. I am just concerned about how to best complete the King's order in a timely manner. Hmmm, you there... are you trustworthy?

yes.0: If... if so, then... can you help me out? A while ago, I received a word from his royal highness that I deliver his letter to #m221000000#, but... well... it is not easy to get there... you're aware that in order to go to #m221000000#, you have to go through Eos Tower, right?
yes.1: Eos Tower... it's FILLED with spiders! Not that I'm SCARED... No! Absolutely not! I just... don't want to get cobwebs on my clothes. If you could just squash #r20#k #r#o2230103#s#k and #r#o2230104#s#k spiders on the #b#m221022500##k and #b#m221022600##k, I'll be able to do what his highness asks for without any problems.

no.0: I cannot say anything to a person who is not trustworthy. Hmm hmm...

1.0: Have you managed to eliminate #o2230103# and #o2230104#? Ohh, that's fantastic! Without them, going through Eos Tower is a piece of cake. Great work there. I will notify the King of your noble achievement.

yes.0: I am definitely not afraid of the spiders. I just... dislike them. Every person has his or her share of dislikes in life.

mob.0: I thought you were gonna get rid of the creepy-crawlies! You just need to squash 20 of those #r#o2230103#s#k and #r#o2230104#s#k spiders on the #b#m221022500##k and #b#m221022600##k. This is all for his highness, so hurry!
